title: Package plan-visualizer as Community Plugin
subtitle: Removes personal coupling (`open-cursor://`, macOS `open`, thorough-planning structure) so any engineer can install and use the agent via `/plugin install plan-visualizer`.

before.title: plan-visualizer Agent
details: Hardcoded `open-cursor://` protocol in plan link href
Step 8.3 auto-opens HTML via macOS `open` command

before.title: open-cursor:// Protocol
details: Custom macOS URL scheme requiring personal AppleScript handler
Requires Cursor editor; no other engineer has this handler registered

before.title: HTML Template
details: Agent fetches via Glob lookup against user-local `~/.claude/agents/references/`

before.title: macOS Auto-Open Step
details: Imposes UX choice; fails silently on Linux/Windows

before.title: marketplace.json
details: No `plan-visualizer` entry yet — agent not discoverable via `/plugin search`

after.title: Community Plugin Agent
details: Moderate fallback parsing — works with any markdown plan format
Profile badge omitted entirely when `**Profile:**` line absent
No personal path assumptions; installable via `/plugin install plan-visualizer`

after.title: file:// Protocol
details: Universal browser protocol — no custom handler or editor required

after.title: Knowledge-Injected Template
details: Auto-injected via `knowledge:` frontmatter — no Glob lookup needed

file_manifest.description: New community plugin agent definition with moderate fallback parsing
HTML template with file:// protocol replacing open-cursor://
Plugin manifest — name, version, author metadata
Add plan-visualizer entry under development-lifecycle category
Personal agent definition — replaced by community plugin
Personal template — replaced by knowledge-injected version

diagrams.title: Plugin Resolution Flow
diagrams.description: How the plugin system resolves the plan-visualizer agent after installation.
diagrams.mermaid:
graph TD
  A["/plugin install plan-visualizer"] --> B[Download to plugins-community/]
  B --> C[Register in marketplace.json]
  C --> D[knowledge: frontmatter injects template]
  D --> E[Agent writes HTML with file:// links]
  E --> F[Browser opens visualization]

key_changes: Agent moved from `~/.claude/agents/` to `plugins-community/plan-visualizer/agents/` — shareable without personal config
`open-cursor://` replaced with `file://` in both agent instructions and HTML template
HTML template now auto-injected via `knowledge:` frontmatter, eliminating Glob-based path lookup
Strict plan-structure validation replaced with 4-level fallback chain supporting any markdown format
macOS `open <path>` step removed — callers decide how to open the output file

tradeoffs.decision: Use knowledge: frontmatter injection instead of Glob-based template lookup
pros: No path assumptions — works regardless of install location
Template auto-available in agent context without extra tool calls
cons: Template size counts against context window budget
Large templates (500+ lines) risk truncation by the knowledge injector

tradeoffs.decision: Moderate fallback parsing instead of strict markdown structure validation
pros: Works with any markdown plan format, not just thorough-planning output
More resilient to plan format changes over time
cons: May extract lower-quality data from loosely structured plans
Harder to give specific error messages when extraction fails

key_decisions: `file://` chosen over `open-cursor://` — universal browser protocol, no custom handler; strictly more portable
`knowledge:` frontmatter for template injection — eliminates path assumptions against user-local `~/.claude/agents/references/`
Moderate fallback parsing over strict validation — compatibility with any markdown plan format, not just thorough-planning output
No auto-open step — removes macOS dependency and avoids imposing UX choice on other engineers

alternatives.title: Keep open-cursor:// with a fallback chain
alternatives.description: Detect which editors are installed and try open-cursor://, then vscode://, then file://.
alternatives.why_rejected: Adds complexity and still requires per-editor URL scheme registration. file:// works everywhere with zero setup.

alternatives.title: Embed template as a Python string in the agent
alternatives.description: Inline the full HTML template directly in the agent markdown as a code block.
alternatives.why_rejected: Would bloat the agent file to 400+ lines and make the template hard to maintain. knowledge: injection keeps them separate.

risks.description: Knowledge injection may truncate large HTML template
risks.mitigation: keep template under 500 lines; document Glob fallback in README

risks.description: `file://` links may be blocked by some browsers' cross-origin restrictions
risks.mitigation: document limitation in README; most browsers allow `file://` to `file://` navigation

out_of_scope: New visualization features or layout changes beyond decoupling
Tests or evals for the plan-visualizer agent
Skills (agent-only plugin — no skill file needed)
